# uptimecheck_alert_channels (Data Source)

The workspace's alert channels (without their secrets). Pick ids for a monitor's channel_ids, e.g. [for c in data.uptimecheck_alert_channels.all.items : c.id if c.type == "slack"].

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Channels set up in the app (SMS, Telegram, push, Add to Slack) are read here, not managed.
data "uptimecheck_alert_channels" "all" {}

locals {
  sms_channel_ids = [for c in data.uptimecheck_alert_channels.all.items : c.id if c.type == "sms"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Every entry in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) false when the channel is paused.
- `id` (String) The channel's id (ch_…), for a monitor's channel_ids.
- `is_default` (Boolean) New monitors in the app get it automatically.
- `name` (String) Shown in the app.
- `type` (String) email, push, slack, teams, discord, google_chat, mattermost, telegram, pagerduty, ntfy, pushover, webhook, sms or voice.
